# The Way

> A free, open-source pixel art RPG that plays in the browser. The player follows Jesus through the Gospels, and every encounter is a choice: listen, serve, pray, or pass by. MIT license. No account and no install.

Season 1, "The Son of Man", has five acts: Galilee, the Mountain, Jerusalem, the Passion and the Resurrection. Choices are tracked by the LOVE system (Level of Virtue Expressed), and the game never forces a choice. Each major story opens a Scroll Room with the Old Testament roots of the scene and a Hebrew or Greek word study. The page is a single canvas drawn by JavaScript, so the game itself has no readable text for a crawler; this file and the README describe it. Made by Kentaro Vadney. Sprite packs are credited in the README.

## Play

- [The Way](https://vadneyk.github.io/the-way/): the game, in the browser
